purpose_1_frozen_implementation_hashes.note: A7 pinned these two scripts mid-repair, so its hashes were stale once the safety corrections landed. A8 supersedes those two hashes only.

purpose_2_safety_corrections_preserved.batch_level_resume: batch composition derives only from the frozen manifests; a batch is skipped only when every unit in it is recorded
purpose_2_safety_corrections_preserved.no_partial_batch_composition: a partially complete batch is rerun in full; --limit is batch-granular as a consequence
purpose_2_safety_corrections_preserved.no_batch6_to_batch1_fallback: the previous BatchCallFailed handler dropped a scorer to batch 1 permanently and continued; now a hard stop
purpose_2_safety_corrections_preserved.irrecoverable_exception_hard_stops: a generator call that raises through all bounded identical-batch retries is a hard stop, not a permanent failure of its six batch-mates
purpose_2_safety_corrections_preserved.successful_batch_retains_valid_rows: when the call succeeds but one row is empty or invalid, only that row fails permanently under the frozen policy; batch-mates are accepted; no reserve substitution
purpose_2_safety_corrections_preserved.stub_cannot_write_protected_targets: the generator now calls the protected-path guard before loading any model; the earlier stub contamination is quarantined and verified stub-only

purpose_3_small_scorer_calibration.calibration_set: the existing 90-task study only; no final-study task is touched
purpose_3_small_scorer_calibration.applied_symmetrically: bounds are absolute values and hold identically whether batching increases or decreases the effect; batching that enlarges the effect is not thereby acceptable
purpose_3_small_scorer_calibration.must_run_on: the same hardware and software environment that will run that scorer's production outputs; a verdict from other hardware licenses nothing
purpose_3_small_scorer_calibration.why_frozen_now: thresholds fixed before any calibration number exists cannot be chosen to suit an observed result

preserved_unchanged: greedy decoding (do_sample=False, seed 42) and all token ceilings
parsers, recovery rules, estimands and the bootstrap plan
explicit_non_claims: NOT claimed that batch 6 is equivalent to batch 1; A6 measured that it is not
NOT claimed that a passing calibration makes batch 6 and batch 1 interchangeable; it means the four frozen bounds were met on the 90-task set, nothing more
NOT claimed that the 90-task calibration set is representative of the 578-task study
